svg.title: The Garden of the Jade Guardian
svg.desc: An eight-storey, symmetrical Chinese fantasy pagoda with jade tiled roofs, vermilion timber, gold dougong brackets, balconies, lattice windows and hanging lanterns. A long jade dragon with gold-edged scales, a pale segmented belly, antler horns, whiskers, flowing mane and four clawed legs coils behind and in front of the tower. Pines, bamboo, scholar rocks, peonies, lotus flowers, koi, a pond, ornamental paths, clouds and mist complete the garden. Every visible element is SVG vector geometry; there are no images, scripts, fonts or external resources.
svg.metadata: Original fantasy composition; not a reconstruction of a historical building. Architectural vocabulary inspired by the octagonal timber structure, corridor balconies and bracket sets of the Wooden Pagoda of Yingxian. Reference: https://whc.unesco.org/en/tentativelists/5803/ . Eight visible floors are an artistic adaptation. Artwork coordinates: 1600 by 2000. Layer order and reusable definitions are explicitly named.
